podcast_a2_ep1_airport.text: Welcome to Spekiva English Podcasts for A2 Elementary. Episode 1: Boarding Pass and Departure Gate. Practice airport check-in, luggage allowance, and boarding procedures.
Good morning! Welcome to SkyWay Airlines. May I please see your passport and flight booking confirmation?
Good morning! Here is my passport and my mobile e-ticket confirmation code.
Thank you, Rachel. I see you are flying to London Heathrow today on flight SK 402. Are you checking in any baggage this morning?
Yes, I have one large suitcase to check in, and I will take this small backpack as my carry-on bag.
Please place your suitcase onto the luggage scale... Perfect, twenty-one kilograms. That is well within your baggage allowance.
That is a relief! Would it be possible to get a window seat, please?
Let me check the seating map... Yes, seat 14A near the front of the cabin is available. It has a great window view.
Wonderful, thank you! What time does boarding begin, and which gate should I go to?
Boarding starts at ten fifteen at Gate 24. Security screening can take fifteen to twenty minutes, so please head through to the departure lounge shortly.
Understood. Is the departure gate on the second floor?
Yes, right after duty-free shops, take the escalator up to the second floor and follow the signs for Gate 24.
Thank you so much for your help! Have a great day!
You are very welcome, Rachel! Here is your passport and boarding pass. Have a safe and pleasant flight!
Episode 1 complete! You now know the key vocabulary for traveling through airports with confidence.

podcast_a2_ep2_hotel.text: Welcome to Episode 2: Hotel Check-in and Special Requests. Learn how to check in smoothly, ask about hotel amenities, and request extra services.
Good afternoon! Welcome to The Grand Harbor Hotel. How can I assist you today?
Good afternoon! I have a reservation for three nights under the name Clara Evans.
Welcome Clara! Let me pull up your booking... Yes, a Deluxe King Room with a city view for three nights. May I have an ID and a credit card for the room deposit?
Certainly, here is my driver's license and credit card.
Thank you. Everything is set. You are in room 512 on the fifth floor. Here are your electronic key cards.
Thank you. Could you please tell me what time breakfast is served in the morning?
Our complimentary buffet breakfast is served on the ground floor terrace from seven to ten thirty in the morning.
That is great. Also, does the room have high-speed Wi-Fi and an iron for clothing?
Yes, Wi-Fi is complimentary throughout the hotel with no password required. There is an iron and ironing board inside the wardrobe.
Could we also get two extra feather pillows and a bottle of mineral water sent up to the room?
Of course, I will notify housekeeping right away, and they will bring them up within ten minutes.
You have been so helpful, James. Thank you very much!
It is our absolute pleasure, Clara. Enjoy your stay in the city!
Episode 2 complete! Remember to use polite modals like 'could you please' when making requests at hotels.

podcast_a2_ep3_shopping.text: Welcome to Episode 3: Shopping Spree and Fitting Rooms. Practice asking for sizes, trying on clothes, asking about discounts, and return policies.
Hello! Welcome to Urban Style. Are you looking for anything in particular today?
Hi! Yes, I really like this navy blue wool sweater on display, but I cannot find my size on the rack.
What size are you looking for?
I am looking for a medium. Do you have any in stock in the back room?
Let me check on our stock system... Yes, we have two medium sweaters in the stockroom. I will grab one for you right now.
Here you go! We also have it in charcoal gray and olive green if you would like to compare colors.
The navy blue looks fantastic! Where are the fitting rooms so I can try it on?
The fitting rooms are located right at the back of the store, next to the shoe section.
It fits perfectly! It is very comfortable and soft. Is this item currently on sale?
Yes, all knitwear is twenty percent off this weekend. So it comes down from sixty dollars to forty-eight dollars.
That is a great bargain! What is your return policy just in case?
You can exchange or return any unworn item with the original tags and receipt within thirty days for a full refund.
Wonderful! I will take the navy sweater, please. I will pay by card.
Excellent choice! Let's head over to the cash register.
Episode 3 complete! Notice how comparatives and polite shopping phrases make everyday purchases easier.

podcast_a2_ep4_doctor.text: Welcome to Episode 4: A Doctor's Visit and Symptoms. Learn how to describe health symptoms, understand medical advice, and get prescriptions.
Good afternoon, Lily. Come on in and have a seat. What seems to be the problem today?
Good afternoon, Dr. Harrison. I haven't been feeling well for the past three days. I have a sore throat, a persistent dry cough, and a mild headache.
I see. Have you had a fever or chills?
Yes, yesterday evening my temperature was thirty-eight degrees, and I felt very exhausted.
Let me examine your throat and listen to your breathing... Open wide and say ah...
Your throat is inflamed and red, but your lungs sound clear. It looks like a viral upper respiratory infection.
Do I need to take antibiotics?
No, antibiotics do not work against viral infections. I will write you a prescription for a soothing throat spray and an anti-inflammatory painkiller.
How often should I take the medication?
Take one painkiller tablet every eight hours after meals with a glass of water, and use the throat spray three times a day.
Is there anything else I should do to recover faster?
You should get plenty of rest, drink warm herbal tea with honey, and stay hydrated. You should avoid cold drinks for a few days.
Thank you very much, Dr. Harrison. I will follow your advice!
You are welcome, Lily. If the fever doesn't go down in forty-eight hours, please come back. Get well soon!
Episode 4 complete! You now know how to explain symptoms and understand medical recommendations.

podcast_a2_ep5_cinema.text: Welcome to Episode 5: Cinema Night and Weekend Plans. Practice talking about films, giving opinions using superlatives, and buying movie tickets.
Hey Zoe! Are you free this evening? There is a brand new sci-fi adventure movie showing at the downtown cinema.
Hey Mark! That sounds exciting! What movie is it?
It is called Galaxy Wanderers. People say it has the most breathtaking visual effects and a thrilling soundtrack.
Oh, I watched the trailer yesterday! The lead actor gave an incredible performance. What time does the screening start?
There is a screening at seven fifteen and another one at nine thirty. Which time do you prefer?
Seven fifteen is much better. That way, we can grab dinner at the Mexican restaurant across the street afterwards.
Great idea! I can book our tickets online right now on my phone. Should we get standard seats or VIP recliner seats?
VIP recliners in the middle row would be awesome! They are much more comfortable than standard seats.
Done! Two VIP tickets for row F, seats 10 and 11. The confirmation code is sent to my email.
You are the best, Mark! Shall we meet in front of the popcorn stand at seven o'clock?
Seven o'clock sharp. I will buy a large butter popcorn and two sodas for us.
Sounds like a perfect Friday evening! See you at seven, Mark!
See you soon Zoe! Can't wait for the movie!
Congratulations! You have completed all 5 A2 Elementary Masterclass podcast episodes. Continue your journey to speak English naturally!
